shared_prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: square ecommerce category photograph, 1:1 composition.
Primary request: Create one convincingly photographic image for a cohesive seven-image category series. Use the provided existing category image only as a subject/motif reference; replace its scene, lighting and styling.
Shared art direction: medium close view at a natural three-quarter angle, pale warm-grey plaster wall behind a lightly textured neutral limestone work surface, soft window daylight entering from upper left, real contact shadows, subdued neutral grading and natural product colors. Delicate material wear and ordinary camera imperfections; realistic glass, metal and plastic. Product fills about 65–75% of the frame, centered, with crop-safe margins and quiet upper-left space for a small UI icon. All objects physically supported.
Constraints: no people, hands, readable text, captions, logos, watermark, collage, CGI/render appearance, levitating objects, exaggerated saturation or cinematic glow. No invented branded product claims. Technically plausible category objects, photograph-like detail rather than decorative 3D design.
